findings_qualitative.value: No CH3OH line detected via aperture, Keplerian masking, matched filter, or stacking

evidence.quote: No methanol lines listed in Table [\[tab:obs_par\]](#tab:obs_par) are detected in the disk around HD 163296 neither individually nor after line stacking.

claims.hypothesis: Is gas-phase CH3OH detectable in the HD 163296 disk?
claims.experiment: ALMA B6/B7 observations with Keplerian masking, matched filter, stacking
claims.result: No detections; 3sigma limits <51 and <26 mJy km/s

evidence.quote: None of the four CH$_3$OH lines are detected in the disk around HD 163296 individually nor after line stacking.

claims.hypothesis: HD 163296 has a lower CH3OH/H2CO ratio than TW Hya
claims.experiment: Column densities with identical method for both disks
claims.finding: HD 163296 is less abundant in methanol relative to formaldehyde

evidence.quote: indicating that the HD 163296 disk has a low amount methanol with respect to formaldehyde relative to the TW Hya disk.

claims.hypothesis: Stellar spectral type/disk structure explains the low ratio
claims.experiment: Discussion comparing to chemical models and scattered light
claims.finding: Possible reasons: shadowing, harder UV, gas-phase H2CO formation

evidence.quote: a higher-than-expected gas-phase formaldehyde abundance, as H$_2$CO may also be formed in the gas phase in the disk upper layers.

why_this_data.value: Lines chosen based on T Tauri chemical modeling and TW Hya detection

evidence.quote: was motivated by the chemical modeling of a disk around a T Tauri star (cite: Walsh2014a)

limitations_admitted.value: Ratio uncertain by a factor of a few; assumes CH3OH shares H2CO emitting area; distance of 122 pc used

evidence.quote: there are uncertainties on the order of a factor of a few when deriving the CH$_3$OH/H$_2$CO ratio as described in this work.
